status: synthetic implementation checks; no retrospective change to the locked primary case
observations: A CaseBudget instance authorizes transfer only while its own live reservation and case BOOTTIME deadline remain unexpired.
Finishing, abandoning, or closing a reservation revokes live transfer authority; abandoned and crashed reservations retain their durable charge.
Reopening the ledger does not restore authority from stranded rows and cannot refund them through finish; a fresh reservation remains subject to the charged totals.
The broker checks authorization before using prepaid credit and before each socket send. Synthetic checks cover finished and expired reservations and restart.
limitations: The deadline check and kernel socket send are separate operations; scheduling can occur between them, so this is not zero-overshoot real-time enforcement.
This is a candidate implementation change after the primary case lock, not a repair or reclassification of that primary outcome.
Prepaid application-byte accounting does not measure lower-layer network framing and conservatively retains unused reserved credit.
